content: HealthKit React Native integration: @kingstinct/react-native-healthkit is the primary library (full TypeScript + Promise support, covers workout read/write). Cannot run in Expo Go — requires custom dev client (expo-dev-client + expo prebuild). @kayzmann/expo-healthkit is a newer Expo-native alternative. Must declare NSHealthShareUsageDescription + NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription in Info.plist. HealthKit capability must be enabled in Xcode Signing & Capabilities. Workouts read as proxies with metadata; write back uses save functions. Real-device testing required (simulator HealthKit is limited).
